newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Aug inflation seen at 0.1-0.2 pct-adviser.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Aug inflation seen at 0.1-0.2 pct-adviser.

text.p: Ukrainian inflation will be around 0.1-0.2 percent in August, far lower than Ukraine had forecast previously, President Leonid Kuchma's economic adviser Valery Lytvytsky said on Friday.

"Everything would be fine if Ukraine did not have such a large wage and pension debt. Such low rates based on unpaid wages can lead to a jump in inflation in the next two months when we start paying the money back," Lytvytsky told Reuters.

Ukraine has promised to pay off the 5.5 billion hryvnias ($3 billion) it owes for months of unpaid wages to government workers, pensions and social benefits in the next few months, using money from its first foreign bond issue this week.
Inflation in the first seven months was 5.4 percent compared with 25 percent during the same period last year.
Officials have forecast annual inflation at 16-17 percent, against 29.7 percent in 1996.
